topic: Attention Mechanism: The Brain of Large Language Models

sections.title: The Core Intuition: The 'It' Problem
lecture_lines: Language depends heavily on surrounding context.
Consider the ambiguous word "it" in sentences.
Attention helps the computer focus on relevant words.
animations: Display the sentence 'The animal didn't cross the street because it was too tired.' in #FFFFFF.
Highlight 'it' in #FFFF00 and 'animal' in #00FF00, then draw a #00FF00 arrow from 'it' to 'animal'.
Fade out the first sentence and display 'The animal didn't cross the street because it was too wide.' in #FFFFFF.
Highlight 'it' in #FFFF00 and 'street' in #0000FF, then draw a #0000FF arrow from 'it' to 'street'.
Flash labels for 'animal' (#00FF00) and 'street' (#0000FF) to emphasize the shift in reference.

sections.title: Prerequisite: Measuring Similarity with Vectors
lecture_lines: Words can be represented as arrows called vectors.
Directions indicate the meaning and relationship of words.
Dot products measure how much these vectors align.
animations: Show two vectors labeled 'Apple' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/apple.svg] and 'Fruit' in #90EE90 pointing in the same direction.
Show two vectors labeled 'Apple' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/apple.svg] and 'Hammer' in #FFB6C1 pointing in opposite directions.
Display a 'Similarity Counter' that increases when #90EE90 vectors align and decreases for #FFB6C1 vectors.

sections.title: The Trinity: Query, Key, and Value (Q, K, V)
lecture_lines: Attention uses three distinct roles: Query, Key, and Value.
Query represents the specific information we seek.
Key acts as a label to match against Query.
Similarity scores determine which Key matches the Query best.
Value provides the actual information for the winning match.
animations: Display a 'Query' object (dog icon) [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/dog.svg] labeled #FFD700 searching for 'Food'.
Label three shelf items as 'Keys': 'Ball' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/ball.svg], 'Leash', and 'Kibble' in #ADFF2F.
Draw a #FFD700 beam from 'Query' to the 'Kibble' Key to show a match.
Display a 'Value' book icon in #00BFFF next to the 'Kibble' Key.
Apply a bright #00BFFF glow to the 'Value' book to show focus being extracted.

sections.title: The Step-by-Step Calculation
lecture_lines: First, calculate similarity by multiplying Query and Key vectors.
These raw scores indicate how words relate to each other.
Softmax converts these scores into normalized probability weights.
Multiply weights by Value vectors to aggregate the information.
The final output highlights the most relevant context.

Display numerical scores (10, 70, 20) over 'The', 'cat' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png], and 'sat' in #FFFF00.
Transform scores into a colored heatmap where 'cat' [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cat.png] glows in #FF4500.
Show three 'Value' boxes scaling their size based on the heatmap intensities.
Merge the scaled boxes into a single 'Output' vector in #00FFFF.

sections.title: Multi-Head Attention: Multiple Perspectives
lecture_lines: Single-head attention might miss complex linguistic nuances.
Multi-head attention uses several parallel attention mechanisms.
Each "head" focuses on different types of relationships.
One head might track grammar, while another tracks logic.
Combining these heads provides a deeper, multidimensional understanding.
animations: Display the sentence 'The chef cooked the meal.' in #FFFFFF.
Shine a #FF0000 spotlight on 'chef' and 'cooked' to show subject-verb relationship.
Shine a #0000FF spotlight on 'cooked' and 'meal' to show verb-object relationship simultaneously.

sections.title: Summary: From Attention to Intelligence
lecture_lines: Attention enables models to process entire sequences at once.
This parallel processing is much faster than reading word-by-word.
It is the core engine driving modern AI intelligence.
animations: Show a robot icon [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/robot.svg] using a magnifying glass to read a sentence word-by-word in #808080.
Show a 'Transformer' grid where all words are connected by #7FFFD4 glowing lines simultaneously.
Pulse the entire grid with #7FFFD4 light to represent high-speed parallel processing.
